statement: The negative elliptic axis of the explicit parabolic surface S8 contracts to its degree-eight elliptic cone germ; H2(Y,ThetaY)=0 and the global-to-local deformation morphism is regular, so any prescribed local smoothing component globalizes to a proper deformation of Y.
depends_on: B.4.10; analytic formal functions; Atiyah extension and actual elliptic-period variation; general analytic local-to-global deformation criterion
notes: Root independent referee PASS. No S6 punctured comparison or compact threefold compactification is asserted. The rational-cycle theorem of Dloussky--Teleman is not applied. This uses standard deformation machinery, with a direct cohomology and obstruction calculation for the explicit member.
